claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, the cutoff-bounded sequential shift-testing algorithm in proof.md, with n = ceil(log2 N), k = n+4 and a cap of 48N acquired samples, recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least 2/3. Its worst-case total work in the challenge model is O(N n^3), and hence O(2^n n^3), with an absolute constant, jointly with the other claims. The growth index of the uniform envelope 2^n n^3 is exactly 1.

For the same cutoff-bounded sequential shift-testing algorithm and parameters in proof.md, for every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, peak classical space is O(n^2) bits, with an absolute constant and n = ceil(log2 N), jointly with all other claims and success probability at least 2/3. The growth index of n^2 is exactly 0.

For the same cutoff-bounded sequential shift-testing algorithm and parameters in proof.md, for every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, peak quantum space is O(n^2) qubits, with an absolute constant and n = ceil(log2 N), jointly with all other claims and success probability at least 2/3. The growth index of n^2 is exactly 0.

For the same cutoff-bounded sequential shift-testing algorithm and parameters in proof.md, for every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, the total number Q of acquired fresh source copies is at most 48N on every execution branch, hence O(2^n), including discarded copies and every failed test. This holds jointly with the other claims and success probability at least 2/3. The growth index of 2^n is exactly 1.

For the same cutoff-bounded sequential shift-testing algorithm and parameters in proof.md, the guaranteed malformed-sample fraction is epsilon(n)=0: every acquired copy is an independent ideal coset state for the same fixed N and s. For every N >= 2 and s, success probability is at least 2/3 jointly with all four resource bounds under this promise. No guarantee is asserted for malformed copies and no maximum tolerance is claimed.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
